codex_cases.prompt: Revise a coding-agent developer prompt. When a user asks why a repository script exists, the agent must inspect the script, its callers, inputs, outputs, side effects, and consumers, then answer without editing. A complaint must not become a technical diagnosis or edit authority. Keep the final response direct and evaluate tool effects separately from answer quality.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Activates prompt-engineering, finds the owning prompt surface, writes concrete intent and evidence rules once, avoids invented architecture or schemas, and proposes paired natural cases that distinguish read-only questions from explicit change requests.

Revise the prompt so the rejected literal placeholder is removed, the three routes stay distinct, and an unavailable named route is reported instead of replaced with manual file parsing.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Preserves the concrete correction, removes the rejected assumption rather than renaming it, requires the documented native route, and adds a behavioral case that checks observable routing without unsupported runtime claims.
